topic_page.headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opens June 11 at Estadio Azteca
topic_page.deck: Historic 48-team tournament across three nations begins with Mexico hosting South Africa in Mexico City.
topic_page.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off on June 11, 2026, at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, marking the first World Cup hosted by three nations. The expanded tournament features 48 teams competing across 16 venues in Canada, Mexico, and the United States over 37 days. With 104 matches scheduled and a $50 million prize for the champions, this historic edition represents the largest World Cup in history.
